infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mico Helper needs microphone access to capture your voice for live meeting notes in Mico.
infoPlist.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Mico Helper needs system audio access to capture other meeting participants' voices on this Mac.
infoPlist.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Mico Helper uses macOS Screen & System Audio Recording to capture meeting audio only. No video or screenshots are saved.
